title: Phase 0 — Foundation
description: Repo setup, shared /core contracts, EF Core scaffolding, auth wiring, and local dev environment. All other work streams depend on this phase.
acceptanceCriteria:
• Solution builds with zero warnings
  • ITenantEntity query filter provably blocks cross-tenant queries in a unit test
  • JWT with a valid tenantId claim populates ITenantContext correctly
  • IManifestReader returns activePacks from Redis; falls back to file on cold start
  • All /core interfaces are defined; no implementation leaks into /core
  • Docker Compose starts BFF, Postgres, Redis, and LocalStack SQS cleanly

title: 01-T1: Repo & solution structure
description: Create solution with /core, /features, /vertical, /bff, /engine folders per A.2 folder spec.
acceptanceCriteria:
• Solution file created with all project references
  • Folder structure matches A.2 specification
  • dotnet build succeeds with zero warnings
  • Directory.Build.props configured (Nullable, TreatWarningsAsErrors, LangVersion)

title: 01-T2: /core contracts
description: Define AuditEvent, TenantContext, IMessaging, IManifestReader, IAdminOverride, INotification, ComplianceProjection, DisputeRaisedEvent, DisputeResolvedEvent interfaces and types.
acceptanceCriteria:
• All 9 interfaces/types defined in /core project
  • No implementation code in /core — interfaces and records only
  • /core project has zero external package dependencies
  • All types are documented with XML comments

title: 01-T3: ServiceDbContext & EF setup
description: Create ServiceDbContext, global ITenantEntity query filter, IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> auto-discovery, LocalStack + Docker Compose wiring.
acceptanceCriteria:
• ServiceDbContext created with global tenant query filter
  • ITenantEntity filter provably blocks cross-tenant queries in unit test
  • IEntityTypeConfiguration auto-discovered from assembly
  • Docker Compose includes PostgreSQL with health check

title: 01-T4: Initial DB migrations
description: Run Admin-first migration order per A.8: Tenant, User, TenantUser, BlueprintActivation.
acceptanceCriteria:
• Migration applies cleanly to fresh PostgreSQL
  • Entity dependency chain: Tenant → User → TenantUser → BlueprintActivation
  • No FK constraint errors on fresh apply
  • Migration is idempotent (re-run doesn't fail)

title: 01-T5: Auth middleware
description: Wire JWT Bearer + API Key dual-scheme policy, ITenantContext extraction from JWT tenantId claim, BFF middleware stack.
acceptanceCriteria:
• JWT Bearer validates against configured OIDC authority
  • API Key scheme validates X-Api-Key header
  • Dual-scheme policy auto-selects based on Authorization header prefix
  • ITenantContext correctly populated from JWT tenantId claim
  • /health endpoint accessible without authentication

title: 01-T6: IMessaging (SQS) wiring
description: Implement SQS publisher for /core event bus; stub consumer base for workspace modules.
acceptanceCriteria:
• IMessaging implementation publishes to SQS queue
  • Consumer base class exists for workspace modules to extend
  • LocalStack SQS queue reachable from Docker Compose
  • Published message retrievable from queue in integration test

title: 01-T7: IManifestReader
description: Implement forge.manifest.json reader backed by Redis; fallback to file on cache miss.
acceptanceCriteria:
• IManifestReader reads from Redis cache first
  • Falls back to file-based read on cache miss
  • Returns activePacks correctly
  • Redis connection configured via appsettings

title: 01-T8: Error middleware & taxonomy
description: Wire global exception handler returning error categories per A.5: Validation, Engine Rejection, Pack Inactive (423), Authorization, Amendment Conflict, System Error.
acceptanceCriteria:
• Global exception handler catches all unhandled exceptions
  • Returns RFC 7807 Problem Details format
  • Maps to correct HTTP status: Validation→400, Authorization→403, Pack Inactive→423, Amendment Conflict→409, System Error→500
  • Engine Rejection returns structured error with rejection reason

title: 01-T9: Local dev smoke test
description: docker compose up → /health returns 200; JWT auth round-trip works; SQS local queue reachable.
acceptanceCriteria:
• docker compose up starts BFF, Postgres, Redis, LocalStack SQS
  • GET /health returns 200 within 30 seconds of startup
  • JWT auth round-trip: get token → call authenticated endpoint → 200
  • SQS local queue reachable and message publish/receive works
  • All services healthy in docker compose ps
